content.raw_text: 玄奘的爸爸叫光蕊。在玄奘出生以前，当光蕊还是一个年轻人的时候，他住在长安。那时候的皇帝叫太宗，他是一个非常聪明的皇帝。国家和平，人们有很多吃的，生活很快乐。

sentences.text: 玄奘的爸爸叫光蕊。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang's father is called Guangrui.
sentences.explanation: This sentence follows the structure of 'A的B叫C', where A possesses B and B is called C. This is a common way to introduce someone's name and relationship in Chinese.

sentences.text: 在玄奘出生以前，当光蕊还是一个年轻人的时候，他住在长安。
sentences.translation: Before Xuanzang was born, when Guangrui was still a young man, he lived in Chang'an.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the background information of Guangrui living in Chang'an before Xuanzang was born. Pay attention to the word order and the use of descriptive words in Chinese.

sentences.text: 那时候的皇帝叫太宗，他是一个非常聪明的皇帝。
sentences.translation: The emperor at that time was called Taizong, he was a very clever emperor.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the emperor at a specific time in history, highlighting his intelligence.

sentences.text: 国家和平，人们有很多吃的，生活很快乐。
sentences.translation: The country is peaceful, people have plenty to eat, and life is very happy.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a peaceful country where people have an abundance of food, leading to a very happy life.

content.raw_text: 有一天，太宗说，“我要举行一次皇宫考试，找到我们国家里最聪明的人，让他们成为我的大臣去帮助人们。我的国家里的每个人都可以来长安考试。”

sentences.text: 有一天，太宗说，“我要举行一次皇宫考试，找到我们国家里最聪明的人，让他们成为我的大臣去帮助人们。
sentences.translation: One day, the Emperor said, "I will hold a palace exam to find the smartest person in our country and make them my minister to help the people."
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the Emperor's plan to hold an exam to find the smartest person in the country and appoint them as a minister to assist the people. The structure of the sentence includes a complex list of actions and intentions.

sentences.text: 我的国家里的每个人都可以来长安考试。
sentences.translation: Everyone in my country can come to Chang'an for the exam.
sentences.explanation: The structure '每个人都可以' means 'everyone can'. '长安' refers to an ancient capital city in China.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark, indicating the end of a quoted text.

content.raw_text: 光蕊听说了皇宫考试，他回家告诉他的妈妈。“皇帝让大家参加考试，”他说，“我想去参加考试。如果我的成绩很好，成为太宗皇帝的大臣，会给我的爸爸妈妈带来荣誉，会帮到我的妻子和我的孩子。当然，我还没有妻子或孩子！但是我想参加考试。我想我会做得很好。”

sentences.text: 光蕊听说了皇宫考试，他回家告诉他的妈妈。
sentences.translation: Guangrui heard about the imperial palace exam, he went home and told his mother.
sentences.explanation: The structure '听说了' indicates hearing about something, and '回家' means returning home.

words.definition: (particle indicating completion of action or change)

sentences.text: “皇帝让大家参加考试，”他说，我想去参加考试。
sentences.translation: The emperor asked everyone to take the exam," he said, "I want to take the exam.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of quotation marks in Chinese writing. It also demonstrates the structure of expressing one's desire using the verb '想' (want) followed by the verb '去' (to go) before the action one wants to do.

sentences.text: 如果我的成绩很好，成为太宗皇帝的大臣，会给我的爸爸妈妈带来荣誉，会帮到我的妻子和我的孩子。
sentences.translation: If my grades are very good, becoming a minister of Emperor Taizong will bring honor to my parents and help my wife and children.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the conditional structure '如果...，会...' (if...will...). It also demonstrates the use of possessive pronouns '我的' (my) and the word '给' (bring) to indicate bringing honor to someone.

sentences.text: 当然，我还没有妻子或孩子！
sentences.translation: Of course, I don't have a wife or children yet!
sentences.explanation: The structure '还没有' is used to express 'do not have yet' in Chinese.

sentences.text: 但是我想参加考试。
sentences.translation: But I want to take the exam.
sentences.explanation: The structure '想 + verb' is commonly used to express the idea of 'want to do something' in Chinese.

sentences.text: 我想我会做得很好。
sentences.translation: I think I will do very well.
sentences.explanation: The structure '会做得很好' is a common pattern in Chinese to express confidence in being able to do something well.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 他的妈妈让他去考试。光蕊去了长安。考试非常难，用了好几天时间。但是在所有参加考试的人中间，光蕊拿了第一名。他是这次考试的状元，意思是“天下第一名读书人。”人们把他放在马上，带他在城市里的街道上游走了三天。

sentences.text: 他的妈妈让他去考试。
sentences.translation: His mother asked him to take the exam.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让他去' means 'asked him to go', which is a common way to express asking someone to do something in Chinese.

sentences.text: 光蕊去了长安。
sentences.translation: Guangrui went to Chang'an.
sentences.explanation: This sentence is a simple subject-verb-object structure, indicating that Guangrui went to Chang'an.

sentences.text: 考试非常难，用了好几天时间。
sentences.translation: The exam was very difficult, took several days.
sentences.explanation: The structure '用了' indicates the action of 'using' has been completed, similar to 'have used' in English.

sentences.text: 但是在所有参加考试的人中间，光蕊拿了第一名。
sentences.translation: But among all the people who took the exam, Guangrui got first place.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the word order in Chinese where the subject 'Guangrui' comes before the verb 'got first place'. The structure '在...中间' is used to indicate 'among' in this context.

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action

sentences.text: 他是这次考试的状元，意思是“天下第一名读书人。
sentences.translation: He is the top scorer of this exam, meaning "the number one scholar in the world".
sentences.explanation: The phrase '状元' refers to the top scorer in the imperial examination system in ancient China. '天下第一' is an idiom meaning 'the best in the world'.

sentences.text: ”人们把他放在马上，带他在城市里的街道上游走了三天。
sentences.translation: People put him on a horse and took him wandering on the streets of the city for three days.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...在...上' is a common way in Chinese to express the action of putting something on a certain object or place.

words.definition: particle used to indicate the object of a verb
particle indicating completion of an action

content.raw_text: 当他骑马走过街道的时候，正好经过洪州丞相的家，殷丞相有一个美丽的女儿叫温娇，没有结婚，她想找一位好丈夫。她做了一个绣球，爬到房子的楼顶上准备扔绣球。她想谁抓住绣球谁就是她的丈夫。就在那个时候，她看到了骑在马上的光蕊，觉得他很漂亮。她也知道他是新的状元，所以她很小心地把绣球扔到了光蕊的头上。他抬头看见了温娇，笑了起来。温娇的朋友和家人跑了出来，把光蕊带到家里，那一天他们就结婚了。

sentences.text: 当他骑马走过街道的时候，正好经过洪州丞相家，殷丞相有一个美丽的女儿叫温娇，没有结婚，她想找一位好丈夫。
sentences.translation: When he rode his horse through the street, he happened to pass by the home of Prime Minister Yin of Hongzhou. Prime Minister Yin had a beautiful daughter named Wen Jiao who was not married, and she wanted to find a good husband.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces characters and their relationships. It also shows the desire of the daughter to find a good husband, reflecting traditional values in Chinese culture.

sentences.text: 她做了一个绣球，爬到房子的楼顶上准备扔绣球。
sentences.translation: She made a embroidered ball and climbed to the top of the house to prepare to throw the embroidered ball.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of the verb '做' (make/do) and the possessive particle '的' to indicate ownership. It also demonstrates the structure of 'verb + 到 + location' to show the direction of an action.

sentences.text: 她想谁抓住绣球谁就是她的丈夫。
sentences.translation: Whoever catches the embroidered ball is her husband.
sentences.explanation: The structure '谁...谁...' in this sentence indicates 'whoever...is...' which is a common pattern in Chinese to express a conditional relationship.

sentences.text: 就在那个时候，她看到了骑在马上的光蕊，觉得他很漂亮。
sentences.translation: At that time, she saw Guangrui riding on a horse and thought he was very handsome.
sentences.explanation: The structure '觉得' followed by a description is a common way to express personal feelings or opinions in Chinese.

sentences.text: 她也知道他是新的状元，所以她很小心地把绣球扔到了光蕊的头上。
sentences.translation: She also knew he was the new champion, so she carefully threw the embroidered ball onto Guangrui's head.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...扔到...' is a common way in Chinese to express throwing something onto someone or something.

words.definition: (particle for marking the object of a verb)

sentences.text: 他抬头看见了温娇，笑了起来。
sentences.translation: He looked up and saw Wen Jiao, then smiled.
sentences.explanation: The structure '看见了' indicates that the action of seeing Wen Jiao is completed. The use of '起来' after '笑了' emphasizes that the action of smiling is starting or in progress.

words.definition: (indicating an action is beginning or in progress)

sentences.text: 温娇的朋友和家人跑了出来，把光蕊带到家里，那一天他们就结婚了。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao's friends and family ran out and brought Guangrui home, and they got married that day.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '了' to indicate the completion of actions. It also demonstrates the structure of using '把' to introduce the object of an action in Chinese sentences.

words.definition: particle used to introduce the object of an action

content.raw_text: 第二天，太宗皇帝问他的大臣们，“我们应该给新状元什么工作？”一个丞相回答说，“江州需要一个州长。”太宗马上让光蕊去江州做州长，而且要他马上离开长安去江州。光蕊回家告诉了他的妻子。然后光蕊和他的妻子温娇、他的妈妈、还有他们的仆人们开始离开长安去江州。

sentences.text: 第二天，太宗皇帝问他的大臣们，“我们应该给新状元什么工作？
sentences.translation: The next day, Emperor Taizong asked his ministers, 'What task should we give to the new top scorer?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces Emperor Taizong asking his ministers about assigning a task to the new top scorer. Note the use of quotation marks in Chinese text.

sentences.text: ”一个丞相回答说，“江州需要一个州长。
sentences.translation: A prime minister replied, "Jiangzhou needs a governor."
sentences.explanation: The structure '一个...需要一个...' means 'a/an...needs a...'.

sentences.text: ”太宗马上让光蕊去江州做州长，而且要他马上离开长安去江州。
sentences.translation: Emperor Taizong immediately sent Guangrui to Jiangzhou to be the governor, and ordered him to leave Chang'an for Jiangzhou immediately.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of multiple verbs in a sequence to express a series of actions. It also demonstrates the use of specific titles and place names in Chinese historical context.

sentences.text: 光蕊回家告诉了他的妻子。
sentences.translation: Guangrui went home and told his wife.
sentences.explanation: This sentence follows a simple subject-verb-object structure commonly used in Chinese sentences. The character '了' is used here to indicate the completion of the action of telling.

sentences.text: 然后光蕊和他的妻子温娇，他的妈妈，还有他们的仆人们开始离开长安去江州。
sentences.translation: Then Guangrui, his wife Wen Jiao, his mother, and their servants started to leave Chang'an for Jiangzhou.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces a group of people leaving one place for another. It includes names of individuals and locations, which are common in Chinese storytelling.

content.raw_text: 这是晚春的季节，轻风吹过树林，小雨打在路边的花草上。

sentences.text: 这是晚春的季节，轻风吹过树林，小雨打在路边的花草上。
sentences.translation: This is the season of late spring, with a gentle breeze blowing through the trees and light rain falling on the flowers and grass by the roadside.
sentences.explanation: The possessive particle '的' is used to connect modifiers to nouns in Chinese. In this sentence, it is used with '晚春' (late spring), '树林' (trees), '路边' (roadside), and '花草' (flowers and grass).

content.raw_text: 几天以后，他们到了洪州。光蕊的妈妈说，“我不太舒服，我们在这里住几天吧，这样我就可以休息一下。”光蕊同意了，他们住在一个叫万花的小酒店。

sentences.text: 几天以后，他们到了洪州。
sentences.translation: A few days later, they arrived in Hongzhou.
sentences.explanation: The structure '几天以后' means 'a few days later'. '到了' is a verb indicating arrival at a place.

sentences.text: 光蕊的妈妈说，“我不太舒服，我们在这里住几天吧，这样我就可以休息一下。
sentences.translation: Guangrui's mother said, 'I'm not feeling well. Let's stay here for a few days so I can rest.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence includes a possessive particle '的' to indicate possession, a modal particle '吧' to suggest a course of action, and the structure '这样...就...' to express 'in this way, then...'.

sentences.text: ”光蕊同意了，他们住在一个叫万花的小酒店。
sentences.translation: Guangrui agreed, they stayed at a small hotel called Wanhua.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一个叫...的小酒店' is a common way to say 'a hotel called ...' in Chinese.

content.raw_text: 那天下午，光蕊去外面走走。他看到有一个人想要卖一条大鱼。光蕊就买了这条鱼，准备把它带回去做晚饭。但当他看着鱼的时候，看到它正在很快地对着他眨眼睛。光蕊对那个卖鱼人说，“我听说当鱼眨眼睛的时候，它就是一个很特别的生物，不只是鱼！我不能吃这条鱼。你在哪里抓到它的？”

sentences.text: 那天下午，光蕊去外面走走。
sentences.translation: That afternoon, Guangrui went outside for a walk.
sentences.explanation: The structure '去外面走走' is a reduplication in Chinese, which emphasizes the action of going outside for a walk.

sentences.text: 他看到有一个人想要卖一条大鱼。
sentences.translation: He saw a person wanting to sell a big fish.
sentences.explanation: The structure '想要' is used to indicate someone wants to do something. In this context, '一条' is a measure word used for long, narrow objects like fish.

sentences.text: 光蕊就买了这条鱼，准备把它带回去做晚饭。
sentences.translation: Guangrui just bought this fish, planning to take it back to cook for dinner.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...带回去' is a common way to express taking something back to a place.

words.definition: measure word for long, narrow objects like fish
(particle marking the object of a verb)

sentences.text: 但当他看着鱼的时候，看到它正在很快地对着他眨眼睛。
sentences.translation: But when he looked at the fish, he saw it blinking quickly at him.
sentences.explanation: The structure '看到' means 'see' in this context, and '正在' is used to indicate an action in progress.

sentences.text: 光蕊对那个卖鱼人说，“我听说当鱼眨眼睛的时候，它就是一个很特别的生物，不只是鱼！
sentences.translation: Guangrui said to the fish seller, 'I heard that when a fish blinks, it is a very special creature, not just a fish!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the concept of a fish being more than just a fish when it blinks, implying there is something special or unique about it.

words.definition: particle used to form an adjective

sentences.text: 我不能吃这条鱼。
sentences.translation: I cannot eat this fish.
sentences.explanation: The tricky grammar structure in this sentence is the use of the measure word '条' before the noun '鱼' to specify that it is a long, narrow object.

words.definition: measure word for long, narrow objects

sentences.text: 你在哪里抓到它的？
sentences.translation: Where did you catch it?
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...哪里' is used to ask where an action took place.

sentences.translation: Chapter 9
sentences.explanation: The sentence simply indicates the chapter number, which is the 9th chapter.

content.raw_text: “我在洪河里抓的，”那人说。光蕊买了鱼，把它带回了洪河，扔进了水里。鱼看了他很长时间，眨了眨眼睛，然后就游入水里了。请记住这件事，因为光蕊会再次见到这条鱼！

sentences.text: “我在洪河里抓的，”那人说。
sentences.translation: I caught it in the Hong River," the man said.
sentences.explanation: The tricky part here is the use of the particle '的' after the verb '抓', which indicates that the action of catching happened in the past.

sentences.text: 光蕊买了鱼，把它带回了洪河，扔进了水里。
sentences.translation: Guangrui bought a fish, brought it back to Honghe, and threw it into the water.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...带回' is a common way in Chinese to express bringing something back from one place to another.

words.definition: used to indicate the object of an action

sentences.text: 鱼看了他很长时间，眨眼睛，然后就游入水里了。
sentences.translation: The fish looked at him for a long time, blinked, and then swam into the water.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of the aspect marker '了' to indicate the completion of an action. It also demonstrates the use of '就' to show an immediate sequence of events.

sentences.text: 请记住这件事，因为光蕊会再次见到这条鱼！
sentences.translation: Please remember this, because Guangrui will see this fish again!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject-Verb-Object. The measure words '件' and '条' are used to quantify the nouns '事' (matter/thing) and '鱼' (fish) respectively. The word '因为' is used to indicate the reason or cause for something.

words.definition: measure word for long, narrow objects

content.raw_text: 三天过去了，但是光蕊的妈妈还是不舒服。光蕊对她说，“皇帝告诉我，我必须马上去江州。我不能再等了。你留在这里，等你好了再走。我给你一些钱，等我回来带你去江州。”

sentences.text: 三天过去了，但是光蕊的妈妈还是不舒服。
sentences.translation: Three days have passed, but Guangrui's mother is still unwell.
sentences.explanation: The structure '但是...还是' is used to express contrast, similar to 'but...still' in English.

sentences.text: 光蕊对她说，“皇帝告诉我，我必须马上去江州。
sentences.translation: Guangrui said to her, 'The emperor told me that I must go to Jiangzhou immediately.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses direct speech with quotes to convey what Guangrui said to the person referred to as 'her'. The structure '必须' (must) followed by '马上' (immediately) emphasizes the urgency of the action required.

sentences.text: 我不能再等了。
sentences.translation: I can't wait any longer.
sentences.explanation: The structure '再...了' is used to indicate that the action cannot continue any longer.

words.definition: indicating completion or change of situation

sentences.text: 你留在这里，等你好了再走。
sentences.translation: You stay here, wait until you feel better before leaving.
sentences.explanation: The structure '等...再...' is used to indicate waiting for a certain condition to be met before doing something.

sentences.text: 我给你一些钱，等我回来带你去江州。
sentences.translation: I will give you some money, and when I come back, I will take you to Jiangzhou.
sentences.explanation: The structure '等...带...' means 'when...then...' in this context, indicating a sequence of events.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark, indicating the end of a quoted text.

content.raw_text: 然后光蕊、温娇和仆人们离开了小酒店继续去江州。他们很快到了洪河。两个船工刘洪和李彪说可以带他们过河。

sentences.text: 然后光蕊，温娇和仆人们离开了小酒店继续去江州。
sentences.translation: Then Guangrui, Wenjiao, and the servants left the small hotel to continue to Jiangzhou.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of names, nouns, and verbs in a simple sentence structure. The use of 了 indicates the completion of the action of leaving the hotel.

sentences.text: 他们很快到了洪河。
sentences.translation: They quickly arrived at the Hong River.
sentences.explanation: The structure '到了' indicates the completion of the action of arriving at a place.

sentences.text: 两个船工刘洪和李彪说可以带他们过河。
sentences.translation: Two boatmen, Liu Hong and Li Biao, said they could take him across the river.
sentences.explanation: The structure '可以带' means 'can take' in this context, with '可以' indicating the ability to do something.

content.raw_text: 我告诉过你，温娇很漂亮。人们说，她的脸像月亮，她的眼睛像秋水，她的美丽会让鸟儿都从天上掉下来，会让鱼儿沉入大海。船工刘洪爱上了她的美丽，希望她成为自己的妻子。所以两个船工把船带到没有人能看到的地方。那天晚上他们杀了仆人，然后打了光蕊，把他扔进了水里。

sentences.text: 我告诉过你，温娇很漂亮。
sentences.translation: I told you, Wen Jiao is very pretty.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '过' after a verb to indicate that the action has occurred in the past. Also, the word '很' is used to intensify the adjective '漂亮' (pretty).

words.definition: used after a verb to indicate that the action has occurred

sentences.text: 人们说，她的脸像月亮，她的眼睛像秋水，她的美丽会让鸟儿都从天上掉下来，会让鱼儿沉入大海。
sentences.translation: People say, her face is like the moon, her eyes are like autumn water, her beauty will make birds fall from the sky, and fish sink into the sea.
sentences.explanation: This sentence uses vivid imagery to describe the beauty of a woman, comparing her to the moon and autumn water. The structure '会让' is used to express the result of her beauty, causing birds to fall from the sky and fish to sink into the sea.

sentences.text: 船工刘洪爱上了她的美丽，希望她成为自己的妻子。
sentences.translation: The boatman Liu Hong fell in love with her beauty, hoping she would become his wife.
sentences.explanation: The sentence follows a simple subject-verb-object structure, with the verb '爱上了' indicating falling in love. The possessive '她的' means 'her', and '自己的' is a reflexive pronoun meaning 'his own'.

sentences.text: 所以两个船工把船带到没有人能看到的地方。
sentences.translation: So the two boatmen took the boat to a place where no one could see.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...带到' is a common Chinese grammar pattern used to indicate taking something to a place.

sentences.text: 那天晚上他们杀了仆人，然后打了光蕊，把他扔进了水里。
sentences.translation: That night they killed the servant, then beat Guangrui, and threw him into the water.
sentences.explanation: The sentence follows a sequence of events: first, the killing of the servant, then the beating of Guangrui, and finally throwing him into the water.

words.definition: particle marking the following noun as the object of a verb

content.raw_text: 温娇想要跳入水中帮她丈夫。但刘洪抓住她说，“你丈夫已经死了，你也会死。除了死你只能成为我的妻子。”温娇知道她自己怀孕了，她想保护自己的孩子。如果她死了，她的孩子也会死。所以她同意成为刘洪的妻子。刘洪把船开到河的另一边，和温娇一起去了江州。当他们到江州的时候，刘洪穿上了光蕊的衣服，告诉人们他是光蕊。现在他有了光蕊的工作，有了妻子温娇。

sentences.text: 温娇想要跳入水中帮她丈夫。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao wanted to jump into the water to help her husband.
sentences.explanation: The structure '想要' means 'wanted to' in this context. '水中' directly translates to 'water' but functions as 'into the water' in this sentence.

sentences.text: 但刘洪抓住她说，“你丈夫已经死了，你也会死。
sentences.translation: But Liu Hong grabbed her and said, 'Your husband is already dead, you will also die.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese may seem different from English, with the verb often placed before the subject. Pay attention to the use of 了 to indicate completion of an action and the future tense marker 会 before the verb.

sentences.text: 除了死你只能成为我的妻子。
sentences.translation: Except for death, you can only become my wife.
sentences.explanation: The structure '除了...只能...' indicates a limitation or restriction, emphasizing that the only option left is the one mentioned.

sentences.text: ”温娇知道她自己怀孕了，她想保护自己的孩子。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao knew she was pregnant, she wanted to protect her child.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the character Wen Jiao who is aware of her pregnancy and desires to safeguard her child. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate the relationship between '自己' (self/own) and '孩子' (child).

sentences.text: 如果她死了，她的孩子也会死。
sentences.translation: If she dies, her child will also die.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject-Verb-Object. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession.

sentences.text: 所以她同意成为刘洪的妻子。
sentences.translation: So she agreed to become Liu Hong's wife.
sentences.explanation: The structure '成为' means 'to become' in this context. The possessive particle '的' indicates the relationship between Liu Hong and his wife.

sentences.text: 刘洪把船开到河的另一边，和温娇一起去了江州。
sentences.translation: Liu Hong drove the boat to the other side of the river and went to Jiangzhou with Wen Jiao.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...开到' is a common way to express 'drive/bring something to a place' in Chinese.

words.definition: indicating the object of the verb

sentences.text: 当他们到江州的时候，刘洪穿上了光蕊的衣服，告诉人们他是光蕊。
sentences.translation: When they arrived in Jiangzhou, Liu Hong put on the clothes of Guangrui and told people that he was Guangrui.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles '的' and the particle '了' indicating the completion of an action. The name 'Guangrui' is repeated to emphasize the character impersonation happening in the sentence.

sentences.text: 现在他有了光蕊的工作，有了妻子温娇。
sentences.translation: Now he has the job of a stamen and a wife Wen Jiao.
sentences.explanation: The structure '有了' indicates that he now possesses the job and wife.

content.raw_text: 现在让我们回到洪河。光蕊死了，尸体沉到在河下。一个河神看到了，跑到龙王宫，说，“大王，一个读书人被杀了，他的尸体被扔进了河里。他现在在河下。”

sentences.text: 现在让我们回到洪河。
sentences.translation: Now let's go back to Honghe.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让我们' means 'let's/we'. The verb '回到' means 'go back to'. '洪河' is a place name.

sentences.text: 光蕊死了，尸体沉到在河下。
sentences.translation: Guangrui died, and the body sank in the river.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the death of someone named Guangrui and the sinking of their body in the river. Pay attention to the use of 了 and 到 to indicate completion of actions.

sentences.text: 一个河神看到了，跑到龙王宫，说，“大王，一个读书人被杀了，他的尸体被扔进了河里。
sentences.translation: A river god saw it, ran to the Dragon King's palace, and said, 'Your Majesty, a scholar has been killed, and his body has been thrown into the river.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains the passive voice structure '被' to indicate the action happening to the subject (the scholar).

sentences.text: 他现在在河下。
sentences.translation: He is now below the river.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...下' is used to indicate someone or something is located below a certain place.
This sentence is enclosed in quotation marks.

content.raw_text: “把尸体带到这里来，”龙王说。河神把尸体带进来，龙王看了看说，“我知道这个人！几天前他帮过我。那个时候我是一条鱼，这个人买了我，把我送回水里。他对我很好，所以我当然要对他很好。”他告诉河神去地狱把光蕊的灵魂拿来。然后龙王把光蕊的灵魂放回他的身体里。光蕊张开眼睛坐了起来。

sentences.text: “把尸体带到这里来，”龙王说。
sentences.translation: Bring the body here,
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...带到...' is a common way in Chinese to express 'bring...to...' where the object being brought is marked by '把' and the destination is marked by '带到'.

words.definition: indicating the object of an action

sentences.text: 河神把尸体带进来，龙王看了看说，“我知道这个人！
sentences.translation: The river god brought the body in, and the dragon king looked and said, 'I know this person!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the river god and dragon king in a mythical context. The structure '把...带进来' indicates the river god brought the body in. The repetition of '看了看' emphasizes the dragon king taking a good look at the body.

words.definition: particle used to indicate the object of a verb
particle indicating completion of an action

sentences.text: 几天前他帮过我。
sentences.translation: A few days ago he helped me.
sentences.explanation: The structure '帮过' indicates that he helped in the past, emphasizing the completion of the action.

sentences.text: 那个时候我是一条鱼，这个人买了我，把我送回水里。
sentences.translation: At that time, I was a fish, and this person bought me and put me back into the water.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the 把 (bǎ) structure in Chinese grammar, which indicates that the object of the verb is being acted upon. In this case, the fish (我 - me) is being put back into the water by the person.

words.definition: indicating the object of the verb is being acted upon

sentences.text: 他对我很好，所以我当然要对他很好。
sentences.translation: He is very good to me, so of course I have to be very good to him.
sentences.explanation: This sentence shows the reciprocal nature of relationships in Chinese culture, where kindness is expected to be reciprocated.

sentences.text: ”他告诉河神去地狱把光蕊的灵魂拿来。
sentences.translation: He told the River God to go to hell and bring back Guangrui's soul.
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a common Chinese grammar structure where the verb '把' is used to indicate the object being acted upon.

sentences.text: 然后龙王把光蕊的灵魂放回他的身体里。
sentences.translation: Then the Dragon King put Guangrui's soul back into his body.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...放回' is a common Chinese construction used to indicate putting something back to its original place.

sentences.text: 光蕊张开眼睛坐了起来。
sentences.translation: Guangrui opened her eyes and sat up.
sentences.explanation: The structure 'verb + 起来' is used to indicate the completion of an action in Chinese.

content.raw_text: “读书人，”龙王说，“你叫什么名字？你从哪里来？为什么你死了？”

sentences.text: “读书人，”龙王说，你叫什么名字？
sentences.translation: Reader,
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject-Verb-Object, with the question word '什么' meaning 'what' used to ask for the name of the reader.

sentences.text: 你从哪里来？
sentences.translation: Where are you from?
sentences.explanation: This sentence is a simple question asking about the origin or place of someone.

sentences.text: 为什么你死了？
sentences.translation: Why did you die?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The particle '了' at the end indicates the completion of an action.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark, indicating the end of a quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: “我叫光蕊。我和我的妻子还有仆人们从长安去江州。在我要过洪河的时候，船工爱上了我的妻子，所以杀了我，把我的尸体扔进河里。我是一个年轻人，我有很多事情要去做。请让我回到生命中去吧，大王！”

sentences.text: “我叫光蕊。
sentences.translation: I am Guangrui.
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple introduction where the speaker is stating their name, Guangrui.

sentences.text: 我和我的妻子还有仆人们从长安去江州。
sentences.translation: My wife, servants, and I went from Chang'an to Jiangzhou.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of '还有' to indicate an additional item or person in a list. '从' is used to indicate the origin of the journey, and '去' is used to show the destination.

sentences.text: 在我要过洪河的时候，船工爱上了我的妻子，所以杀了我，把我的尸体扔进河里。
sentences.translation: When I was about to cross the Hong River, the boatman fell in love with my wife, so he killed me and threw my body into the river.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles '的' and '了', as well as the particle '把' used to introduce the object of an action. The structure '在...的时候' is a common way to express 'when' in Chinese.

words.definition: particle used to introduce the object of an action

sentences.text: 我是一个年轻人，我有很多事情要去做。
sentences.translation: I am a young person, I have many things to do.
sentences.explanation: The structure '要去' indicates an intention or necessity to do something in the future.

sentences.text: 请让我回到生命中去吧，大王！
sentences.translation: Please let me return to life, Your Majesty!
sentences.explanation: The phrase '请让' together means 'please let'. The term '大王' is a respectful way to address a king or ruler in Chinese.

sentences.translation: Chapter 9
sentences.explanation: The sentence simply states the chapter number in Chinese, which is 'Chapter 9'. The word '第' is an ordinal number prefix used before numbers to indicate order or sequence.

content.raw_text: “我的朋友，”龙王说，“你不知道吧，你帮助过我。那个时候我是一条鱼，你买了我，把我放回到河里。现在我会帮你的。”

sentences.text: “我的朋友，”龙王说，你不知道吧，你帮助过我。
sentences.translation: My friend,
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject-Verb-Object. The use of modal particle '吧' at the end of the sentence softens the tone and makes it sound more like a suggestion or assumption.

sentences.text: 那个时候我是一条鱼，你买了我，把我放回到河里。
sentences.translation: At that time, I was a fish, you bought me, and put me back into the river.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a situation where the speaker was a fish that someone bought and then released back into the river. The structure '把...放回' is a common Chinese construction used to indicate putting something back to its original place.

sentences.text: 现在我会帮你的。
sentences.translation: Now I will help you.
sentences.explanation: The structure '会 + verb' indicates the future tense in Chinese. The possessive particle '的' is used to show possession.
This sentence only contains opening and closing quotation marks, indicating a quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 龙王在光蕊的嘴里放了一个神奇的珍珠，把他的身体和他的灵魂连在一起。“现在，你可以等在我的宫殿里。我会想办法让你回到你的生命中去的。”

sentences.text: 龙王在光蕊的嘴里放了一个神奇的珍珠，把他的身体和他的灵魂连在一起。
sentences.translation: The Dragon King placed a magical pearl in Guangrui's mouth, connecting his body and his soul.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '把' to indicate the object of an action in Chinese grammar.

words.definition: particle used to indicate the object of an action

sentences.text: “现在，你可以等在我的宫殿里。
sentences.translation: Now, you can wait in my palace.
sentences.explanation: The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession in Chinese. The word order in Chinese is subject-verb-object, so '你可以' means 'you can'.

sentences.text: 我会想办法让你回到你的生命中去的。
sentences.translation: I will find a way to get you back into your life.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让...回到...' means 'to get...back into...'.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 现在让我们再回到温娇，她只能成为强盗刘洪的妻子。她真的很想杀了刘洪，但她不能。她等着孩子的出生，但是她又非常担心刘洪会杀死孩子。

sentences.text: 现在让我们再回到温娇，她只能成为强盗刘洪的妻子。
sentences.translation: Now let's go back to Wen Jiao, she can only become the wife of the bandit Liu Hong.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. In this sentence, the tricky part might be the use of '只能' which means 'can only' in this context.

sentences.text: 她真的很想杀了刘洪，但她不能。
sentences.translation: She really wanted to kill Liu Hong, but she couldn't.
sentences.explanation: The structure '想 + verb' is used to express 'want to do something'. The particle '了' in this context indicates the completion of an action.

sentences.text: 她等着孩子的出生，但是她又非常担心刘洪会杀死孩子。
sentences.translation: She waits for the birth of the child, but she is very worried that Liu Hong will kill the child.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the verb before the object, which may differ from English. The use of '又' emphasizes the repeated or additional worry the subject has.

content.raw_text: 有一天，刘洪有事出城了，温娇正在想着她死去的丈夫。突然她的肚子痛了起来，她生下一个男孩。后来，她和她手中的孩子都睡着了，她做了一个梦。

sentences.text: 有一天，刘洪有事出城了，温娇正在想着她死去的丈夫。
sentences.translation: One day, Liu Hong had something to do and went out of the city, while Wen Jiao was thinking about her deceased husband.
sentences.explanation: The structure '正在...着' indicates an ongoing action in Chinese. The possessive particle '的' is used to show possession in this context.

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action

sentences.text: 突然她的肚子痛了起来，她生下一个男孩。
sentences.translation: Suddenly her stomach started hurting, she gave birth to a baby boy.
sentences.explanation: The structure '痛了起来' is a common way in Chinese to indicate the start of an action or state, in this case, the stomach pain started. Also, '生下' is a verb phrase meaning 'to give birth to'.

sentences.text: 后来，她和她手中的孩子都睡着了，她做了一个梦。
sentences.translation: Later, she and the child in her arms both fell asleep, and she had a dream.
sentences.explanation: The structure '她和她手中的孩子' means 'she and the child in her arms', where '的' is a possessive particle indicating possession.

content.raw_text: 梦中她听到一个声音说，“注意听着，亲爱的温娇！我是南极星君。有一天，你的孩子会成为一个有名的人，成为佛祖的仆人。但是现在他有危险。你必须保护他！不要担心你亲爱的丈夫，他还活着，在龙王宫里等着你。你们会再次在一起的。记住我的话。现在快醒来！快醒来！”

sentences.text: 梦中她听到一个声音说，“注意听着，亲爱的温娇！
sentences.translation: In her dream, she heard a voice saying, 'Pay attention, dear Wen Jiao!'
sentences.explanation: The structure '注意...着' indicates listening while paying attention. The term '亲爱的' is a term of endearment used before a person's name.

sentences.text: 我是南极星君。
sentences.translation: I am the Southern Star Lord.
sentences.explanation: The phrase '南极星君' refers to the Southern Star Lord, which is a title or name in this context.

sentences.text: 有一天，你的孩子会成为一个有名的人，成为佛祖的仆人。
sentences.translation: One day, your child will become a famous person, becoming a servant of the Buddha.
sentences.explanation: The structure '会成为' is used to indicate future tense in Chinese.

sentences.text: 但是现在他有危险。
sentences.translation: But now he is in danger.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The word '但是' is used to indicate a contrast or transition in the sentence.

sentences.text: 你必须保护他！
sentences.translation: You must protect him!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is subject-verb-object, with the verb '保护' (protect) placed between the subject '你' (you) and the object '他' (him). The exclamation mark '！' adds emphasis to the command.

sentences.text: 不要担心你亲爱的丈夫，他还活着，在龙王宫里等着你。
sentences.translation: Don't worry about your beloved husband, he is still alive, waiting for you in the Dragon King's palace.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...里' is used to indicate location, meaning 'in/at'. The phrase '等着' means 'waiting for'.

sentences.text: 你们会再次在一起的。
sentences.translation: You will be together again.
sentences.explanation: The structure '会再次在一起' means 'will be together again.' The possessive particle '的' at the end indicates the relationship between the subject and the action.

sentences.text: 记住我的话。
sentences.translation: Remember my words.
sentences.explanation: The structure '记住我的话' means 'remember my words'. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession in Chinese.

sentences.text: 现在快醒来！
sentences.translation: Wake up now!
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Adverb + Verb. The adverb 快 (quickly) is used to emphasize the urgency of waking up.

sentences.text: 快醒来！
sentences.translation: Wake up quickly!
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the imperative form to command someone to wake up quickly.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark, which indicates the end of a quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 温娇醒了，想到了梦中听到的话。但就在这个时候，刘洪回到了家里。他看到这个男孩，想要马上杀死他。但温娇说，“今天太晚了，我的丈夫。我们等到明天一起去把孩子扔进河里。”刘洪同意了。

sentences.text: 温娇醒了，想到了梦中听到的话。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao woke up and thought of the words she heard in her dream.
sentences.explanation: The structure '想到了' means 'thought of' with the particle '了' indicating completion of the action. The possessive particle '的' is used to link '梦中' (in the dream) and '话' (words).

sentences.text: 但就在这个时候，刘洪回到了家里。
sentences.translation: But at this moment, Liu Hong returned home.
sentences.explanation: The structure '就在这个时候' is a common way to express 'at this moment' in Chinese.

sentences.text: 他看到这个男孩，想要马上杀死他。
sentences.translation: He saw this boy and wanted to kill him immediately.
sentences.explanation: The structure '想要' is used to express the intention or desire to do something, similar to 'want to' in English.

sentences.text: 但温娇说，“今天太晚了，我的丈夫。
sentences.translation: But Wen Jiao said, 'It's too late today, my husband.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '今天太晚了' means 'It's too late today', where '了' indicates a change in the situation.

sentences.text: 我们等到明天一起去把孩子扔进河里。
sentences.translation: We will wait until tomorrow to go together and throw the child into the river.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure '把...扔进...' is a common way in Chinese to express throwing something into somewhere. It's important to note that the action described in this sentence is not something that should be done in real life, as it is harmful and inappropriate.

words.definition: marker for the object of the action

sentences.text: ”刘洪同意了。
sentences.translation: Liu Hong agreed.
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple statement where Liu Hong agrees to something. The particle '了' indicates the completion of the action.

content.raw_text: 但是第二天早上，刘洪有事必须再次出去。温娇知道她没有太多的时间。她想写一封信，但没有毛笔和墨，她就咬了自己的手指，用手指上的血写信。这封信讲了孩子的故事，要求有人照顾他。她把信包起来捆在孩子身上。然后她从小孩的左脚上咬下一个小脚趾，这样她以后如果见到他就会认得他。

sentences.text: 但是第二天早上，刘洪有事必须再次出去。
sentences.translation: But the next morning, Liu Hong had to go out again.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains the structure '有事必须', which means 'have to do something'.

sentences.text: 温娇知道她没有太多的时间。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao knew she didn't have much time.
sentences.explanation: The structure '没有太多的' means 'not much' in this context.

sentences.text: 她想写一封信，但没有毛笔和墨，她就咬了自己的手指，用手指上的血写信。
sentences.translation: She wanted to write a letter, but without a brush and ink, she bit her own finger and used the blood on her finger to write the letter.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the determination of the character to write a letter despite not having the necessary tools, leading her to use her own blood as ink.

sentences.text: 这封信讲了孩子的故事，要求有人照顾他。
sentences.translation: This letter tells the child's story and asks someone to take care of him.
sentences.explanation: The structure '要求有人照顾他' means 'asks someone to take care of him'. The possessive marker '的' is used to show the relationship between '孩子' (child) and '故事' (story).

sentences.text: 她把信包起来捆在孩子身上。
sentences.translation: She wrapped the letter up and tied it to the child.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...包起来' is a common way in Chinese to express wrapping something up.

words.definition: particle used to indicate the object of a verb

sentences.text: 然后她从小孩的左脚上咬下一个小脚趾，这样她以后如果见到他就会认得他。
sentences.translation: Then she bit off a little toe from the child's left foot, so she would recognize him if she saw him again.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a gruesome act of mutilation, where the woman bites off a child's toe to be able to recognize him in the future.

content.raw_text: 温娇和孩子来到河边。她看到水上有一块木板。她把孩子放在木板上，然后把带着信的孩子和木板捆在一起。她站在那里看着孩子和木板在河中漂得很远一直到看不见。

sentences.text: 温娇和孩子来到河边。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao and the child came to the riverside.
sentences.explanation: The sentence follows a simple subject-verb-object structure, with '和' meaning 'and' to connect '温娇' (Wen Jiao) and '孩子' (child). '来到' is a verb phrase meaning 'came to' and '河边' means 'riverside'.

sentences.text: 她看到水上有一块木板。
sentences.translation: She saw a wooden plank on the water.
sentences.explanation: The structure '有一' is commonly used to indicate the existence of something in Chinese.

sentences.text: 她把孩子放在木板上，然后把带着信的孩子和木板捆在一起。
sentences.translation: She placed the child on a wooden board, then tied the child with the letter together with the board.
sentences.explanation: The sentence demonstrates the use of the particle '把' to indicate the object of the verb, as well as the possessive particle '的'.

words.definition: particle used to indicate the object of a verb

sentences.text: 她站在那里看着孩子和木板在河中漂得很远一直到看不见。
sentences.translation: She stood there watching the children and the planks drift far away in the river until they were out of sight.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一直到' is used to indicate the action continues until a certain point, in this case, until the planks are out of sight.

words.definition: used to link verb and complement

content.raw_text: 孩子在水上漂了几个小时，一直漂到金山寺脚下。庙里的方丈听到孩子的哭声，跑到河边，抱住孩子。他读了血写的信，把孩子带回了庙里，给了他一个名字叫江流。

sentences.text: 孩子在水上漂了几个小时，一直漂到金山寺脚下。
sentences.translation: The child drifted on the water for several hours, drifting all the way to the foot of Jinshan Temple.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一直...到' is a common way to express that something continues until a certain point or destination.

sentences.text: 庙里的方丈听到孩子的哭声，跑到河边，抱住孩子。
sentences.translation: The abbot in the temple heard the child's crying, ran to the riverbank, and hugged the child.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of possessive particles '的' to indicate possession, as well as the verb-object structure commonly seen in Chinese sentences.

sentences.text: 他读了血写的信，把孩子带回了庙里，给了他一个名字叫江流。
sentences.translation: He read the letter written in blood, brought the child back to the temple, and gave him a name called Jiang Liu.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...带回' is a common Chinese construction where '把' marks the object of the verb '带回' (bring back).

words.definition: (particle marking the object of a verb)

content.raw_text: 江流住在庙里。他和方丈一起学习，但是他不知道他的爸爸妈妈、他的出生，因为方丈没有告诉他。江流十八岁那年，方丈给他剃了头，给了他玄奘这个名字。

sentences.text: 江流住在庙里。
sentences.translation: The river flows through the temple.
sentences.explanation: The tricky part here is the use of the verb "住" (reside) to describe the flow of the river, which can be confusing for learners. Also, the word order in Chinese is different from English, with the location (庙里) coming after the verb (住在).

sentences.text: 他和方丈一起学习，但是他不知道他的爸爸妈妈，他的出生，因为方丈没有告诉他。
sentences.translation: He studied together with the abbot, but he didn't know about his parents, his birth, because the abbot didn't tell him.
sentences.explanation: The structure '他的爸爸妈妈' means 'his parents' where '他的' means 'his', '爸爸' means 'father', and '妈妈' means 'mother'.

sentences.text: 江流十八岁那年，方丈给他剃了头，给了他玄奘这个名字。
sentences.translation: When Jiang Liu was eighteen years old, the abbot shaved his head and gave him the name Xuanzang.
sentences.explanation: In this sentence, the abbot shaved Jiang Liu's head and gave him the name Xuanzang when he was eighteen years old.

content.raw_text: 有一天，玄奘正在和另一个年轻和尚一起学佛法。那个年轻和尚很生气，因为玄奘比他聪明多了，那个和尚喊道，“你是什么啊？你都不知道自己的名字和你爸爸妈妈的名字。你为什么和我们一起在这里？”

sentences.text: 有一天，玄奘正在和另一个年轻和尚一起学佛法。
sentences.translation: One day, Xuanzang was studying Buddhist scriptures with another young monk.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + 正在 + Verb + Object, which indicates an ongoing action in progress.

words.definition: Xuanzang (name of a Buddhist monk and scholar)

sentences.text: 那个年轻和尚很生气，因为玄奘比他聪明多了，那个和尚喊道，“你是什么啊？
sentences.translation: The young monk was very angry because Xuanzang was much smarter than him. The monk shouted, 'What are you?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases a comparison structure using '比' (compared to). The particle '啊' at the end of the sentence expresses the monk's surprise or doubt.

words.definition: particle used at the end of a sentence to express surprise or doubt

sentences.text: 你都不知道自己的名字和你爸爸妈妈的名字。
sentences.translation: You don't know your own name and your parents' names.
sentences.explanation: The structure '自己的' is used to indicate 'own' in Chinese.

sentences.text: 你为什么和我们一起在这里？
sentences.translation: Why are you here with us?
sentences.explanation: The structure '为什么' means 'why' in this context. The use of '一起' emphasizes the action of being together.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark, which indicates the end of a quotation.

content.raw_text: 玄奘去方丈那里哭了起来。方丈说，“跟我来玄奘，”他们两人进了方丈的房间。方丈在房间里的一个秘密地方拿出了那封血写的信，给了玄奘。

sentences.text: 玄奘去方丈那里哭了起来。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang went to the abbot's room and started crying.
sentences.explanation: The structure '哭了起来' is a common way in Chinese to indicate that someone started crying.

sentences.text: 方丈说，“跟我来玄奘”他们两人进了方丈的房间。
sentences.translation: The abbot said, 'Come with me, Xuanzang,' and the two of them entered the abbot's room.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the action of the abbot inviting Xuanzang to come with him into the abbot's room. Pay attention to the possessive particle '的' and the particle indicating completed action '了'.

sentences.text: 方丈在房间里的一个秘密地方拿出了那封血写的信，给了玄奘。
sentences.translation: The abbot took out the letter written in blood from a secret place in the room and gave it to Xuanzang.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains possessive marker '的' and the particle '了' indicating a completed action. The measure word '封' is used for letters.

content.raw_text: 玄奘读了这封信，然后对方丈说，“这十八年来，我住在这里，但不知道我的名字和我的家人。现在我知道我是谁了。亲爱的方丈，请让我去找我的妈妈，为我爸爸的死报仇！”

sentences.text: 玄奘读了这封信，然后对方丈说，“这十八年来，我住在这里，但不知道我的名字和我的家人。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang read the letter and then said to the abbot, 'For the past eighteen years, I have been living here, but I do not know my name or my family.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject-Verb-Object. The use of '但不知道' (but do not know) is a common structure to express not being aware of something.

sentences.text: 现在我知道我是谁了。
sentences.translation: Now I know who I am.
sentences.explanation: The structure '我是谁' (who I am) is a common way to express self-realization in Chinese.

sentences.text: 亲爱的方丈，请让我去找我的妈妈，为我爸爸的死报仇！
sentences.translation: Dear abbot, please let me go find my mother to avenge my father's death!
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses a polite form of request '请' (please) followed by the verb '让' (let) to ask for permission to do something. The phrase '为...报仇' means 'to avenge...' in this context.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 方丈回答说，“你当然可以去。穿上一件一般的和尚衣服，去你妈妈住的州长家。”

sentences.text: 方丈回答说，“你当然可以去。
sentences.translation: The abbot replied, 'Of course you can go.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The word '当然' emphasizes the speaker's certainty or agreement in this context.

sentences.text: 穿上一件一般的和尚衣服，去你妈妈住的州长家。
sentences.translation: Put on a regular monk's robe and go to the governor's house where your mother lives.
sentences.explanation: This sentence includes the structure '穿上...，去...' which means 'put on... and go to...'. The measure word '一件' is used for clothing in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 玄奘穿得像一个小和尚，去了州长家。刘洪再次有事出去了，因为上天要玄奘和他妈妈两人见面。而且前一天晚上，温娇梦中再次见到了她的儿子。所以当玄奘到她家的时候，她马上打开门，问道，“你是谁？”

sentences.text: 玄奘穿得像一个小和尚，去了州长家。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang dressed like a little monk and went to the governor's house.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes Xuanzang dressing like a young monk and visiting the governor's house.

words.definition: used after a verb to indicate possibility or capability

sentences.text: 刘洪再次有事出去了，因为上天要玄奘和他妈妈两人见面。
sentences.translation: Liu Hong went out again because the heavens wanted Xuanzang and his mother to meet.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Predicate + Object. In this sentence, the reason for Liu Hong going out again is explained by the conjunction '因为' (because), and the action of the heavens wanting Xuanzang and his mother to meet is indicated by the verb '要' (want).

sentences.text: 而且前一天晚上，温娇梦中再次见到了她的儿子。
sentences.translation: And the previous night, Wen Jiao once again saw her son in her dream.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains the structure '再次见到' which means 'saw once again'. Also, pay attention to the possessive particle '的' used in '她的儿子' (her son).

sentences.text: 所以当玄奘到她家的时候，她马上打开门，问道，“你是谁？
sentences.translation: So when Xuanzang arrived at her house, she immediately opened the door and asked, "Who are you?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the time phrase at the beginning, followed by the subject and action. The use of quotation marks indicates direct speech.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 玄奘说，“我是金山寺的小和尚。”

sentences.text: 玄奘说，“我是金山寺的小和尚。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang said, "I am a little monk from the Jinshan Temple."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure follows the pattern of 'Subject + 是 + Noun' to indicate identity. The use of '小和尚' (little monk) is a common term to refer to a young monk.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 温娇从头到脚地看着他，请他进来，给他菜和米饭吃。她又问，“你是谁？你为什么离开家人？”

sentences.text: 温娇从头到脚地看着他，请他进来，给他菜和米饭吃。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao looked at him from head to toe, invited him in, and served him food and rice.
sentences.explanation: The structure '从头到脚' (from head to toe) is a common way to describe looking at someone or something thoroughly. The use of '地' before '看着' indicates the manner in which Wen Jiao looked at him.

words.definition: used before a verb to indicate an adverbial phrase

sentences.text: 她又问，“你是谁？
sentences.translation: She asked again, "Who are you?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Adverb + Verb + Punctuation, followed by a quotation with a question mark at the end.

sentences.text: 你为什么离开家人？
sentences.translation: Why did you leave your family?
sentences.explanation: The structure '为什么' means 'why' in this context and is commonly used to ask for reasons or explanations.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: “我没有离开我的家人，”玄奘说。“我的爸爸被杀死了，我的妈妈被迫和杀死她丈夫的男人结婚。我的仇像海那样深，我要为我的爸爸妈妈报仇。”

sentences.text: “我没有离开我的家人，”玄奘说。
sentences.translation: I did not leave my family,
sentences.explanation: The structure '没有...，' is used to indicate negation in Chinese. The name '玄奘' refers to the famous Chinese Buddhist monk and scholar Xuanzang.

sentences.text: “我的爸爸被杀死了，我的妈妈被迫和杀死她丈夫的男人结婚。
sentences.translation: My father was killed, and my mother was forced to marry the man who killed her husband.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the passive voice in Chinese, where the subject is the one receiving the action rather than performing it. It also demonstrates the possessive particle '的' to indicate possession.

words.definition: passive marker indicating the subject is affected by the action
passive marker indicating the subject is affected by the action

sentences.text: 我的仇像海那样深，我要为我的爸爸妈妈报仇。
sentences.translation: My hatred is as deep as the sea, I will avenge my parents.
sentences.explanation: The sentence expresses strong emotions of hatred and vengeance towards the speaker's parents. The structure '要为...报仇' means 'to avenge for...' in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “你爸爸妈妈是谁？”温娇问。

sentences.text: “你爸爸妈妈是谁？
sentences.translation: Who are your parents?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a question asking about the identity of someone's parents.

sentences.text: ”温娇问。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao asked.
sentences.explanation: This sentence consists of a person's name '温娇' followed by the verb '问' (asked), indicating that Wen Jiao asked something.

content.raw_text: “我爸爸的名字叫光蕊，妈妈的名字叫温娇。我叫江流，但是在我十八岁生日的时候，方丈给了我玄奘这个名字。”然后他给温娇看了那封血写的信。温娇知道这个和尚就是她的儿子，玄奘知道这个女人就是他的妈妈。

sentences.text: “我爸爸的名字叫光蕊，妈妈的名字叫温娇。
sentences.translation: My father's name is Guangrui, and my mother's name is Wenjiao.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the names of the speaker's parents. The structure '的名字叫' is commonly used to introduce someone's name in Chinese.

sentences.text: 我叫江流，但是在我十八岁生日的时候，方丈给了我玄奘这个名字。
sentences.translation: My name is Jiang Liu, but on my eighteenth birthday, the abbot gave me the name Xuanzang.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...的时候' is used to indicate 'at the time of' or 'when'. The name 'Xuanzang' refers to a famous Chinese Buddhist monk and scholar who traveled to India in the 7th century.

sentences.text: ”然后他给温娇看了那封血写的信。
sentences.translation: Then he showed Wen Jiao the letter written in blood.
sentences.explanation: The structure '给...看' is used to indicate showing something to someone in Chinese.

sentences.text: 温娇知道这个和尚就是她的儿子，玄奘知道这个女人就是他的妈妈。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao knew that this monk was her son, Xuanzang knew that this woman was his mother.
sentences.explanation: This sentence uses simple vocabulary but introduces the structure '就是' to indicate 'is' or 'was'. It also shows possessive pronouns '她的' (her) and '他的' (his).

content.raw_text: 但是就在他想要说什么的时候，温娇喊道，“你必须马上离开！”

sentences.text: 但是就在他想要说什么的时候，温娇喊道，“你必须马上离开！
sentences.translation: But just as he was about to say something, Wen Jiao shouted, 'You must leave immediately!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure involves the use of '就在...的时候' to indicate 'just as...'. The phrase '喊道' is used to describe someone shouting.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark, which indicates the end of a quotation or dialogue.

content.raw_text: “为什么？”玄奘问。“我已经生活了十八年，不知道我的爸爸妈妈是谁。现在我见到了我的妈妈，她让我马上离开。这是为什么？”

sentences.text: “为什么？
sentences.translation: Why?
sentences.explanation: The sentence consists of the word '为什么' meaning 'why' followed by a question mark.

sentences.text: ”玄奘问。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang asked.
sentences.explanation: This sentence is a simple question where Xuanzang is asking something.

sentences.text: “我已经生活了十八年，不知道我的爸爸妈妈是谁。
sentences.translation: I have lived for eighteen years, and I don't know who my parents are.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Time + Verb + Object, which is different from English. In this sentence, the speaker expresses their age and the fact that they do not know who their parents are.

sentences.text: 现在我见到了我的妈妈，她让我马上离开。
sentences.translation: Now I saw my mother, she asked me to leave immediately.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让我' means 'asked me to', which is a common way to express someone asking another person to do something in Chinese.

sentences.text: 这是为什么？
sentences.translation: Why is this?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object, so '这' means 'this', '是' means 'is', and '为什么' means 'why'. The question mark '？' indicates a question.
This sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “就像你在火上一样，你必须马上离开，”温娇回答。“强盗刘洪很快就会回来，如果他看到你，他会马上杀死你的。但是我有一个办法，你回到你的庙里，在那里等着我。”

sentences.text: “就像你在火上一样，你必须马上离开，”温娇回答。
sentences.translation: Just like you're on fire, you must leave immediately,
sentences.explanation: The structure '就像...一样' is a common way to express 'just like...'. The use of '必须' (must) emphasizes the necessity of leaving immediately.

sentences.text: “强盗刘洪很快就会回来，如果他看到你，他会马上杀死你的。
sentences.translation: Bandit Liu Hong will come back soon. If he sees you, he will kill you immediately.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses conditional structure '如果...，他会...' to express a possible future outcome. The word '就' emphasizes the immediacy of the action.

words.definition: indicating the immediacy of an action

sentences.text: 但是我有一个办法，你回到你的庙里，在那里等着我。
sentences.translation: But I have a way, you go back to your temple, wait for me there.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese can be different from English, with the subject often placed before the verb. In this sentence, the verb '等着' (wait for) is followed by the object '我' (me).
This sentence seems to be incomplete, as it ends with a quotation mark. It may be a cliffhanger or a pause in the text.

content.raw_text: 玄奘听了她的话，就那样做了。第二天，温娇不起床也不吃饭，她告诉仆人她不舒服。刘洪进了她的房间。她对他说，“小时候，我想送一百双鞋给庙里的和尚，但是我没有这样做过。昨天晚上我做了一个梦，一个和尚对我很生气，告诉我，我应该送鞋给他们。因为这，我现在生病了。”

sentences.text: 玄奘听了她的话，就那样做了。
sentences.translation: Xuanzang listened to her words and did as she said.
sentences.explanation: The sentence follows a typical subject-verb-object structure in Chinese. The use of '了' after a verb indicates the completion of an action, and '就' is used to show that an action is done accordingly or as a result of something.

sentences.text: 第二天，温娇不起床也不吃饭，她告诉仆人她不舒服。
sentences.translation: The next day, Wen Jiao did not get out of bed or eat. She told the servant she was not feeling well.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the character Wen Jiao who is feeling unwell and communicates this to her servant.

sentences.text: 刘洪进了她的房间。
sentences.translation: Liu Hong entered her room.
sentences.explanation: The sentence follows a Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) structure commonly used in Chinese. The particle '了' indicates the completion of the action of entering.

sentences.text: 她对他说，“小时候，我想送一百双鞋给庙里的和尚，但是我没有这样做过。
sentences.translation: She said to him, 'When I was young, I wanted to donate one hundred pairs of shoes to the monks in the temple, but I have never done so.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple clauses and the use of the possessive particle '的'. The phrase '小时候' means 'when I was young'.

sentences.text: 昨天晚上我做了一个梦，一个和尚对我很生气，告诉我，我应该送鞋给他们。
sentences.translation: Last night I had a dream, a monk was very angry with me, telling me that I should give them shoes.
sentences.explanation: The structure '告诉我' means 'told me', with the verb '告诉' (to tell) followed by the object '我' (me). The phrase '我应该' means 'I should', with '我' (I) followed by '应该' (should).

sentences.text: 因为这，我现在生病了。
sentences.translation: Because of this, I am sick now.
sentences.explanation: The structure "因为...了" is used to indicate the reason for a current situation or action.
This sentence contains quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 刘洪说，“这么小的一个问题！不用担心。”然后他要求一百家中每一家必须给他一双鞋子。五天以后，他拿到了一百双鞋子。

sentences.text: 刘洪说，“这么小的一个问题！
sentences.translation: Liu Hong said, 'Such a small problem!'
sentences.explanation: The structure '这么...一个' is used to emphasize the small size of the problem. The exclamation mark '！' indicates strong emotion or emphasis.

sentences.text: 不用担心。
sentences.translation: Don't worry.
sentences.explanation: The structure 不用 followed by a verb indicates 'don't need to' or 'no need to' in Chinese.

sentences.text: ”然后他要求一百家中每一家必须给他一双鞋子。
sentences.translation: Then he demanded that each of the one hundred families must give him a pair of shoes.
sentences.explanation: The structure '每一家' means 'each of the families' and '一双' means 'a pair'.

sentences.text: 五天以后，他拿到了一百双鞋子。
sentences.translation: Five days later, he received one hundred pairs of shoes.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一百双' is used to indicate 'one hundred pairs' in Chinese, where '双' means 'pairs'.

content.raw_text: “现在我们有了鞋子，”他对温娇说，“你想把它们送到哪里？”

sentences.text: “现在我们有了鞋子，”他对温娇说，“你想把它们送到哪里？
sentences.translation: Now that we have shoes,
sentences.explanation: This sentence includes the structure '对...说' meaning 'said to', and the use of '把' as a preposition indicating the object of the action.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 温娇说，“我听说金山寺是个好地方。我会去那里。你很忙，你留在这里，不用帮我，就给我两个仆人吧。”

sentences.text: 温娇说，“我听说金山寺是个好地方。
sentences.translation: Wen Jiao said, 'I heard that Jinshan Temple is a good place.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '听说' means 'heard that' in this context. '个' is a measure word used before nouns to indicate singularity.

sentences.text: 我会去那里。
sentences.translation: I will go there.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is subject + modal verb + verb + location. The use of "会" indicates a future action.

sentences.text: 你很忙，你留在这里，不用帮我，就给我两个仆人吧。
sentences.translation: You are very busy, stay here, you don't need to help me, just give me two servants.
